paper.title: Monte-Carlo Tree Search by Best Arm Identification

settings.name_in_paper: Best action identification in a maximin game tree with stochastic leaves (simple MCTS model)
unmapped: Arms are the leaves of a known maximin game tree (K = |L| leaves); the goal is an epsilon-optimal root action whose value is defined by recursive max/min over the tree, not an epsilon-best arm
fixed-confidence (epsilon, delta)-PAC identification with a stopping rule
the learner knows the tree structure
settings.definition_quote: Given a risk level $\delta$ and some accuracy parameter $\epsilon \geq 0$ our goal is have a recommendation $\hat{s}_\tau \in \cC(s_0)$ whose value is within $\epsilon$ of the value of the best move, with probability larger than $1-\delta$, that is $\bP\left(V(s_0) - V(\hat{s}_\tau)  \leq \epsilon \right) \geq 1 - \delta.$

settings.name_in_paper: Best action identification in a maximin game tree, epsilon = 0 (lower bound)
unmapped: Arms are the leaves of a known maximin game tree; the goal is to identify the best root action (value defined by recursive max/min)
the learner knows the tree structure
settings.definition_quote: Given a tree $\cT$, a MCTS model is parameterized by the leaf values, $\bm\mu := (\mu_{\ell})_{\ell \in \cL}$, which determine the best root action: $s^*=s^*(\bm\mu)$. For $\bm \mu \in [0,1]^{|\cL|}$, We define $\mathrm{Alt}(\bm\mu) = \{ \bm \lambda \in [0,1]^{|\cL|} : s^*(\bm\lambda) \neq s^*(\bm\mu)\}$.

conditions: delta <= max(0.1*|L|, 1) as stated (Theorem 3 uses delta <= min(1, 0.1|L|))
tuning: beta(s,delta) = ln(|L|/delta) + 3 ln ln(|L|/delta) + (3/2) ln(ln s + 1)

source.label: lem:PAC
source.quote: If $\delta \leq \max(0.1 |\cL|,1)$, for the choice $\beta(s,\delta) = \ln (|\cL|/\delta) + 3 \ln\ln(|\cL|/\delta) + (3/2) \ln (\ln s+1)$ both UGapE-MCTS and LUCB-MCTS satisfy $\bP(V(s^*) - V(\hat{s}_\tau) \leq \epsilon ) \geq 1-\delta$.

results.notes: (epsilon,delta)-correctness: probability of returning a non-epsilon-optimal root action is at most delta. K = |L| number of leaves.

tuning: beta(s,delta) = ln(|L|/delta) + 3 ln ln(|L|/delta) + (3/2) ln(ln s + 1)

source.label: lem:PAC
source.quote: If $\delta \leq \max(0.1 |\cL|,1)$, for the choice $\beta(s,\delta) = \ln (|\cL|/\delta) + 3 \ln\ln(|\cL|/\delta) + (3/2) \ln (\ln s+1)$ both UGapE-MCTS and LUCB-MCTS satisfy $\bP(V(s^*) - V(\hat{s}_\tau) \leq \epsilon ) \geq 1-\delta$.

results.notes: Same lemma as r1, for LUCB-MCTS.

bound.expression_latex: 8 H^*_\epsilon(\bm\mu) \ln \frac{|\mathcal L|}{\delta} +\sum_\ell   \frac{16}{\overline{\Delta}_{\ell,\epsilon}^2} \ln\ln \frac{1}{\overline{\Delta}_{\ell,\epsilon}^2} + 8H^*_\epsilon(\bm\mu) \left[3\ln \ln \frac{|\mathcal L|}{\delta} + 2  \ln \ln \left(8 e \ln \frac{|\mathcal L|}{\delta} + 24e \ln \ln \frac{|\mathcal L|}{\delta}\right)\right] + 1

symbols.H_star_eps: complexity sum over leaves of 1/(Delta_l^2 v Delta_*^2 v epsilon^2)
symbols.Dbar_l: Delta_l v Delta_* v epsilon for leaf l, where Delta_l = max over non-root ancestors s of |V_s - V(parent(s))| and Delta_* = V(s*) - V(s*_2)

conditions: K = |L| is the number of leaves
tuning: exploration function beta(s,delta) = ln(|L|/delta) + 3 ln ln(|L|/delta) + (3/2) ln(ln s + 1)

source.label: thm:MCTSSC
source.quote: Let $\delta \leq \min(1,0.1|\cL|)$. UGapE-MCTS using the exploration function~\eqref{def:ExploRate} is such that, with probability larger than $1-\delta$, $\left(V(s^*) - V(\hat{s}_\tau) < \epsilon\right)$ and, letting $\overline{\Delta}_{\ell,\epsilon}=\Delta_\ell \vee \Delta_* \vee \epsilon$, \tau \le 8 H^*_\epsilon(\bm\mu) \ln \frac{|\mathcal L|}{\delta} +\sum_\ell \frac{16}{\overline{\Delta}_{\ell,\epsilon}^2} \ln\ln \frac{1}{\overline{\Delta}_{\ell,\epsilon}^2} + ...

results.notes: Sum over arms is over leaves. Also guarantees epsilon-correctness on the same event. Bernoulli leaves (paper says algorithms apply to [0,1]-bounded oracles).

symbols.Htilde_star_eps: sum over leaves of 1/(tildeDelta_l^2 v Delta_*^2 v epsilon^2), with tildeDelta_l = max over ancestors excluding root and depth-one node of |V(s) - V(parent(s))|

conditions: K = |L| is the number of leaves
tuning: variant that samples the representative leaves of both promising depth-one nodes each round and stops at even rounds

source.label: thm:MCTSSCLUCB
source.quote: Let $\delta \leq \min(1,0.1|\cL|)$. LUCB-MCTS using the exploration function~\eqref{def:ExploRate} and selecting the two promising leaves at each round is such that, with probability larger than $1-\delta$, $\left(V(s^*) - V(\hat{s}_\tau) < \epsilon\right)$ and \[\tau \leq 16\tilde{H}^*_\epsilon(\bm\mu)\left[ \ln\frac{|\cL|}{\delta} + 3 \ln\ln\frac{|\cL|}{\delta} + 2 \ln\ln\left(16e\tilde{H}^*_\epsilon(\bm\mu) \left(\ln\frac{|\cL|}{\delta}+3\ln\ln\frac{|\cL|}{\delta}\right)\right)\right]. \]

results.notes: Applies to a slight variant of LUCB-MCTS (two leaves per round).

conditions: T_star here is the tree version: T*(mu)^{-1} = sup_w inf_{lambda in Alt(mu)} sum_l w_l d(mu_l, lambda_l), Alt = leaf means changing the best root action

source.label: thm:LBgene
source.quote: Assume $\epsilon=0$. Any $\delta$-correct algorithm satisfies $\bE_{\bm\mu}[\tau] \geq T^*(\bm\mu) d(\delta,1-\delta), \ \ \text{where} \ \ \ T^*(\bm\mu)^{-1} := \sup_{\bm w \in \Sigma_{|\cL|}}\inf_{\bm \lambda \in \mathrm{Alt}(\bm\mu)} \sum_{\ell \in \cL} w_\ell d\left(\mu_\ell,\lambda_{\ell}\right)$

results.notes: T_star used with the tree-structured Alt set rather than plain BAI. Paper notes d(delta,1-delta) >= ln(1/(2.4 delta)).
